p.src: 1  Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

p.src: 2  in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

p.src: 4  to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

p.src: 5  I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

en: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

p.src: 6  if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

p.src: 7  For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

p.src: 8  but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

p.src: 9  holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

p.src: 11  whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
